BETWEEN:-
 GAJENDRA KATARE S/O SHRI KAVILAS KATARE, AGE-  36 YEARS, R/O HANUMAN MANDIR, ADITYPURAM,

DISTRICT GWALIOR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI PRADEEP KATARE - ADVOCATE FOR THE APPLICANT)
 AND  STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION MAHARAJPURA, DISTRICT GWALIOR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .
 (SHRI P.S. RAGHUVANSHI - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR  RESPONDENT/STATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is second repeat bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant.

First bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 29.05.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.17699 of 2023.

The applicant is in custody since 23.03.2023 in connection with Crime No.233/2023 registered at Police Station Maharajpura, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
506 IPC.
As per prosecution story, the present applicant happens to be the priest of the temple.
Prosecutrix had asked him to visit home for the purpose of performance of some Pooja but as alleged he committed rape against her wishes when she was all alone at home.
Accordingly, case has been registered against the applicant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated.
The applicant has suffered incarceration since 23.03.2023.
Investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
Therefore, no further custodial interrogation is required.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is a major lady of 42 years having children and medical evidence does not corroborate commission of offence.
Under such circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail on such terms and conditions this Court deems fit and proper.

P e r contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application supporting the order impugned with submission that looking to the seriousness of the offence, no exception can be taken in the matter of grant of bail to him.

U p o n hearing learned counsel for the rival parties but without commenting upon the rival contentions touching merits of the case, regard being had to the fact that the applicant is in jail since 23.03.2023 and charge-sheet has been filed after completion of investigation, in the obtaining facts and circumstances, the applicant is held entitled for enlargement on bail but with stringent conditions.
Consequently, the application of the applicant filed under Section 439 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 is hereby allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lacs only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court and on the condition that he shall remain present before the Court concerned during trial and also comply with the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 with following further condition:
(i) the applicant shall mark his attendance before the concerned police station on 2nd and 4th Saturday of every month between 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon.
Observations made on facts touching merits of the case are only for the purpose of deciding the instant bail application and shall not have any bearing on the pending trial.
Registry is directed to send a copy of this order to all the concerned including the concerned Station House Officer of the Police Station for information and necessary action.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ROHIT ARYA) JUDGE (Dubey)
